sources.title: Tiny Aya Fire model card
sources.evidence: Exact Fire card identifies Cohere and Cohere Labs, South Asian specialization, open weights, CC-BY-NC-4.0 plus acceptable-use terms, nominal 3.35B size, and text input/output. Its isolated 111B terms paragraph conflicts with its explicit size and is a copy error, not a Fire count. Reopened October 27, 2026: the exact card still explicitly gives Model Size 3.35B and supplies no separate active count.

sources.title: Tiny Aya: Bridging Scale and Multilingual Depth
sources.evidence: Fire is the South Asian regional release. Section 3.1/Table 2 give a dense decoder-only Transformer, 36 layers, 2048 hidden width, GQA, 3:1 sliding/full attention, 3.35B total parameters and 8192-token input/output. Section 3.3 states regional checkpoints share architecture; section 5 compares against non-thinking models. Independently inspected the full report freshly fetched October 27, including Table 2 and Section 3.3. The table labels 2.8B non-embedding and 3.35B total; neither is labeled active. Regional and global checkpoints share architecture and tokenizer for direct parameter-space merging.

sources.title: Cohere Labs Launches Tiny Aya, Making Multilingual AI Accessible
sources.evidence: Dated February 17, 2026; embedded article body announces immediate open-weight availability and explicitly names TinyAya-Fire as the South Asian variant. Page metadata gives datePublished 2026-02-17T04:00:07.000-05:00.

sources.title: Tiny Aya Fire repository metadata and published chat template
sources.evidence: Exact repository reports Cohere2ForCausalLM/cohere2, tiny-aya-base ancestry, gated BF16 weights and 3,349,227,520 safetensors elements. Its template handles system/user/assistant text with START_RESPONSE, without tools, tool_calls, tool-role rendering or thinking branches. Metadata is accessible although direct configuration/index downloads return HTTP 401. Fresh October 27 metadata at revision 73500c80fcb6c8bea3e830c21d5d2920249a0e1a still reports 3,349,227,520 BF16 elements and names CohereLabs/tiny-aya-base. The aggregate corroborates nominal size rather than an active-count convention.

sources.title: Transformers Cohere2 model implementation
sources.evidence: The implementation selected by Fire metadata uses dense q/k/v/output projections and a three-projection gated MLP in each decoder layer, parallel attention/MLP residuals, and sliding or full causal attention. RoPE frequencies are nonpersistent buffers; implementation alone is not an exact Fire checkpoint count.

sources.title: Tiny Aya Fire checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Direct raw, blob and resolve access returned HTTP 401. Exact class metadata was available through s4; numerical architecture/context evidence comes from s2.

sources.title: Tiny Aya Fire tensor index
sources.evidence: HTTP 401 prevented tensor-index/header inspection. No weight shards were downloaded; the nominal first-party count is retained instead of asserting an independently verified exact tensor count.

sources.title: Tiny Aya documentation
sources.evidence: Exact tiny-aya-fire row gives 3.35B, South Asian specialization and 8k input/output. Describes five Tiny Aya family members and identifies Fire as an instruction-tuned Chat model with downloadable open weights. No Fire-native tool-calling or dedicated thinking mode is documented. Reopened October 27: the exact Fire row still lists 3.35B under Parameters, without an active-parameter column.

sources.title: Basic usage of tool use (function calling)
sources.evidence: Introduces native tool use for the Command family. This is not evidence that Tiny Aya Fire supports the same native interface.

sources.title: Tiny Aya Base model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27 for the exact named base. It states nominal 3.35B and links Fire as the South Asian chat variant. No separate active count is defined for the base, so the explicit fine-tuning lineage does not resolve the missing active field.

sources.title: Building Multilingual Bridges: Data Mixing as the Pillar of Generalization for In-Language Reasoning
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the complete later first-party report freshly fetched October 27, including Section 3.1, parameter terminology and comparisons. It describes a 3.35B Tiny Aya base and post-trained Thinker models, but gives no active/activated count for Fire or an applicable base-model counting convention. The later reasoning capability is not transferred to Fire.

sources.title: How small AI models can make a big impact for enterprises
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 reading of the September 2, 2026 first-party comparison confirms the Tiny Aya family size as 3.35B. Its explicitly separated 30B total and 3B active values belong to North Mini Code, not Tiny Aya; it does not establish a dense-model active-count convention.

sources.title: Multilingual Bridges: How Data Mixing Unlocks In-Language Reasoning
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 reading of the October 2026 first-party article confirms 3.35B for the later L2-Thinker and names its Tiny Aya Base 32K lineage. Its comparison discusses performance and reasoning-token efficiency, not active-parameter counts for Fire or the original Tiny Aya base.

developer.note: Cohere and its Cohere Labs research organization are the developers.

family.note: Tiny Aya is the named model family; Fire is its South Asian regional member.

release_date.note: Primary launch announcement names Fire and immediate availability; earlier repository creation is not a public release date.

open_weights.note: Weights are released with a terms-acceptance gate and noncommercial restrictions.

license.note: Repository license identifier; Cohere acceptable-use addendum also applies.

parameters_b.note: Fresh exact card, documentation, original report and later first-party comparison confirm the nominal 3.35B complete total. Current Hub metadata corroborates the scale at 3.349227520B. Preserve published precision without requiring an exact tensor census; the isolated 111B terms boilerplate is not a Fire specification.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-model total/active/lineage searches, reopened original evidence and later first-party comparisons found no separate active count or applicable developer convention. Table 2 explicitly labels 2.8B non-embedding, not active. The named base and unchanged regional merging architecture establish lineage, but supply no active count to inherit; the total is not copied into this field.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Transformer. Fire metadata selects Cohere2ForCausalLM; shared architecture is explicit in the report, and the implementation has dense MLPs rather than routed experts.

context_window.note: Table 2 specifies 8192 input tokens. The docs/card shorthand 8k does not establish 8000; output is separately 8192, not additive to this field.

modalities.note: Exact model card explicitly states text-only input and generated text output.

reasoning.note: The report disables thinking in comparison models for fair evaluation; it does not explicitly classify Fire native/API mode support. The exact Fire template only opens response content and has no thinking branch. Dedicated reasoning capability remains unverified rather than treating absence as an explicit negative.

tool_call.note: No exact Fire-native tool interface verified. Its published template lacks tool rendering and its docs list ordinary Chat use; generic Command support cannot justify the baseline true. Clear to unknown rather than claiming a tested negative.

description.value: Compact multilingual model specialized for South Asian languages
description.note: Matches the explicitly named regional specialization; Fire is distinct from Global and Base.

patch.notes: Tiny Aya Fire is the South Asian regional instruction-tuned model. 3.35B is Cohere's nominal total; active parameters are not separately disclosed. Input context is 8,192 tokens, with output separately specified as 8,192. The native template has no thinking or tool-call branches; dedicated reasoning and native tool calling remain unverified. The model card's 111B terms boilerplate conflicts with its explicit 3.35B specification.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit confirms the nominal 3.35B total and retains an undisclosed active count. Fresh exact-model searches, reopened card/docs/base/metadata, the original report and later Thinker report and Cohere comparisons supply no separate active-count convention. The 2.8B non-embedding figure is not relabeled active. Added explicit patches and refreshed evidence while preserving unrelated assessments; no shards or repeat census requested.
